## Modules

.claude/_extracted/padam-av/ape/ape_hook.py
conftest.py — Root conftest: ensures repo root is on sys.path so `scripts.*` imports resolve.
console/standards_console/__init__.py — Local management console for the chrysa shared standards fleet.
console/standards_console/__main__.py — ``python -m standards_console`` entrypoint.
console/standards_console/app.py — FastAPI JSON API behind the React SPA.
console/standards_console/compliance.py — Read fleet compliance from the hosted guideline-checker central server.
console/standards_console/compliance_reader.py — Read fleet compliance from the local ``compliance/*-conformance.json`` snapshots.
console/standards_console/config.py — Typed configuration: env-driven settings + a YAML constants referential.
console/standards_console/distribution.py — Pilot the ``distribute-standards`` workflow and surface its activity.
console/standards_console/github_gateway.py — The single point of contact with the GitHub REST API.
console/standards_console/manifest.py — Read and edit ``repos.yml`` while preserving comments and layout.
console/standards_console/mcp_server.py — Read-only MCP server exposing the chrysa fleet standards over stdio.
console/standards_console/rules_reader.py — Read the fleet standards *rules* from local files (read-only).
console/standards_console/schemas.py — Pydantic request/response models for the JSON API consumed by the React SPA.
console/standards_console/services.py — Wire settings + gateway + the four service objects together.
console/standards_console/standard.py — Edit the canonical standard and copilot instructions via a pull request.
console/standards_console/views.py — Presenter functions: turn service data into API response models.
console/tests/__init__.py
console/tests/conftest.py — Shared fixtures: a fake gateway and a wired Services for app-level tests.
console/tests/test_app.py
console/tests/test_compliance.py
console/tests/test_compliance_reader.py — Unit tests for the local compliance reader (offline fixtures).
console/tests/test_config.py
console/tests/test_gateway_writes.py — Cover the branch/PR/run helpers of the gateway.
console/tests/test_github_gateway.py
console/tests/test_manifest.py
console/tests/test_mcp_server.py — Tool-level tests for the standards MCP server (handlers called directly).
console/tests/test_rules_reader.py — Unit tests for the standards rules reader (offline fixtures).
scripts/__init__.py — Scripts package — enables importable modules under scripts/.
scripts/check-repos-archived-drift.py
scripts/check_domains_drift.py — Drift gate: the GV-015 prose table and standards/domains.yaml are one source.
scripts/ci_annexe_audit.py — Audit the fleet against annexe CI (`standards/annexes/CI-CD.md`), and fix what is safe.
scripts/ci_changelog_action.py — Move repos off an inlined git-cliff call and onto `chrysa/github-actions/changelog`.
scripts/ci_pin_actions_sha.py — Pin third-party GitHub Actions by commit SHA (CI-010).
scripts/ci_secrets_explicit.py — Replace `secrets: inherit` with the explicit list the callee actually declares (CI-021).
scripts/gen_agent_views.py — Generate the agent views from the canonical standards corpus.
scripts/gen_context_files.py — Generate the standardised per-repo context files from the repo's own content.
scripts/github_actions_pin.py — Keep the fleet's `chrysa/github-actions` pins on a single, current tag.
scripts/pii/__init__.py — PII (GDPR) detection package: Presidio recognizers, config, and scanner.
scripts/pii/config.py — Load PII scan configuration and false-positive allowlist.
